articleTitle: Possibility to use renewable energy sources for increasing the reliability of the responsible energy consumers on the enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: As the title implies the article describes energy consumption analysis of the enterprise. This article considers the possibility of using renewable energy sources to provide emergency needs of the enterprise. The article analyzes the energy consumption of the enterprise, proposes the possibility of creating an integrated energy system based on RES. It is proposed to reduce energy costs through the use of non-conventional and renewable energy sources as a perspective area of world energy. Much attention is given to the metrological data the source of which is the NASA portal received from the satellite, visual diagrams are constructed. The article presents calculations of the system, graphs of its operation, summarizes the possibility of its creation. It is proposed to reduce energy costs through the use of non-conventional and renewable energy sources as a promising area of world energy.

articleTitle: Accuracy analysis of shunt current sensing by means of delta-sigma modulation in electric drives
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper considers the accuracy of the shunt current measurement by means of delta-sigma modulation in electric drives. The shunt current sensing becomes more popular with the appearance of the galvanically isolated delta-sigma modulator ICs and microcontrollers with embedded demodulators. This solution is much cheaper than closed-loop Hall-effect sensor, and it is already implemented in some commercial electric drives. In this paper the accuracy of delta-sigma bitstream demodulation is considered. The dependences between oversampling ratio, digital filter type, input signal value and the maximum error were obtained from the model.

articleTitle: Development and optimization of multi-motor asynchronous electric drives for carding machines
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In this paper we describe the main results of the development and optimization of the multi-motor asynchronous electric drive of carding devices. The synchronous rotation of asynchronous motors is developed by the improvement of the “electric working shaft” system with the use of thyristor converters, frequency converters, double-feed machines. In this case, the synchronous rotation of the drive motors is supported by maintaining the power circuit and connecting the rotor circuits to a three-phase resistance. In this article we consider the synchronization of asynchronous motors in the “EWS” system (electric working shaft) facilitating the synchronous start-up of the engines of the carding machines and their synchronous braking, excluding the preliminary synchronization, as well as synchronous start-up. The equations of the moments of a multi-motor asynchronous electric drive of coordinated rotation for the unbalanced feeding of their motors, consisting of the moments of the engines with forward and reverse directions of rotation of the magnetic field are given. In subsequent developments with MAED microprocessor control, asynchronous motors with a phase rotor are used instead of asynchronous motors with a short-circuited rotor, and synchronous rotation of the drive motors is solved by using frequency converters controlled from industrial microcontrollers. For further optimization of the electric drive of the carding machine, the principles of the double-feed machines were applied. In this case, the MAED carding device is controlled from the rotor side by frequency converters with and without maintaining the power connection of the rotor circuits. At the same time, the necessary power of frequency converters for controlling the electric drive of the carding machines is reduced by 2-2.5 times.

articleTitle: To issue of designing scalar closed-loop controllers for frequency controlled induction motor drives
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The publications in the field of scalar closed-loop controllers for frequency controlled induction motor drives are shortly reviewed. The following structures of scalar closed-loop control systems are given: speed stabilized without magnetic flux stabilization, only magnetic flux stabilized, both speed and flux stabilized, also optimal and quasi-optimal structures are discussed. Moreover, classification of scalar control system by the type of speed regulator is given, and approaches to the regulators' structure design are described. In addition, several types of optimal and quasi-optimal scalar control systems are reviewed. The information about so-called complex modes optimization of electrical drive with induction motor is provided.

articleTitle: Currents in bearings of induction motors of electric drives with semiconductor converter
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The most regular problem of electric drives with semiconductor system is drive electric engine's bearing assembly renny damage. The bearing currents bring a number of damages in drive electric engine. These currents can perform continuous action on the bearing assembly. The reasons for having bearing currents in modern drive' s actuator machine were demonstrated in this paper. The main kinds of bearing currents were allocated and described. The characteristic was not lost. A negative effect was registered. The effect of long and short bearing currents' influence was also registered. Here the authors presented the main methods of measures and control bearing currents. The ways of preventing bearing currents were analyzed. Their effective influence was analyzed. A recommendation of using them in modern electric drive were presented. The main international standard documents were given. This document regulates possible determination of bearing currents and present show ways of preventing them. The recommendation of development native standard base on bearing currents were given. The bearing currents drive motor with semiconductor converter of frequency will be explored. A research will consist in the mathematical model construction processes of their appearance accounting for the working mode as autonomous inverter, electric motor and grounding. An analysis will be presented by simulation modeling and designing algorithmic ways of their elimination.

articleTitle: Investigation of traction linear induction motor for conveyor train
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper reviews the results of the study of a traction linear induction motor (LIM) for conveyor transport in the mining industry. The design of the traction motor is described. The results of calculating the characteristics of the engine using the method of detailed magnetic replacement circuits are given. The influence of the choice of the ferromagnetic material (massive steel 3, steel 20, alloy of steel 2211) of the secondary element (SE) on the engine characteristics is studied. The influence of the saturation of the ferromagnetic layer of SE on the traction force of the engine is shown. The normal forces (attraction and levitation) acting on the conveyor train cart are evaluated. The calculated design parameters of the engine are compared with the data obtained by the engine manufacturer.

articleTitle: SRPU balance monitoring by wattmeter card
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: One of key indicators that influence the energy consumption of induction motor of a sucker-rod pumping unit (SRPU) is pumpjack balance which is defined by the counterweight position on the crank - the key parameter of machine mechanical set-up. It addressed the current ways of determining the balance and it identified their weaknesses. It determined that the most affordable and reliable of SRPU diagnostics means is wattmetering. The article considers a SRPU computer model for research patterns and operating modes of unit. The algorithms of the determination of pumpjack balance, counterweight optimum position and “dead centres” are developed. The algorithms do not require mounting any external sensors on the unit and may be operated as a part of the SRPU intelligent control station software providing for a simplicity of control, maintenance and cost cutting.

articleTitle: Starting mode of three-stage brushless generator operation
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Recent years the design of electrical equipment in aircraft in the part of electrical systems inclines to combining the functions of a starter system for generating electrical energy in one unit which was named the starter-generator. This solution allows improving mass and dimensions parameters and increasing reliability. This trend became especially apparent in connection with the implementation of the concept of a “fully electric aircraft” which led to a significant increase in the capacity and functionality of generators and devices for converting electrical energy into both primary and additional generation channels; in its turn, it made it possible to realize the motor (starter) mode using the generation channels. The article considers the possibility of realizing the motor operating modes of a three-stage brushless generator with a damper winding which allows it to be used as a starter in the process of starting a gas turbine engine. The relations to determine the duration of the first stage of starting the gas turbine engine are provided in the article.

articleTitle: Method for monitoring the condition of the motor winding insulation
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper presents some results of the investigation of an induction motor stator winding insulation leakage currents which are generated by rectangular voltage pulses with frequencies of 100-2000 Hz. The authors consider the possibility of recording the leakage current parameters and the dependence of these parameters on the amplitude and frequency of the voltage pulses with the aim of using this information to monitor the state of isolation. It is shown that the proposed way makes it is possible to obtain relatively large values of leakage currents which simplifies the operation with them. However, to reliably determine the amplitude of the leakage current peaks, a relatively long measurement period with a large number of transmitted pulses is necessary. Otherwise, the equipment is required that provides a sufficiently high resolution (sample time of the order of 10(1e-6) seconds or less).

articleTitle: Sensorless vector control of asynchronous machine based on reduced order Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article describes sensorless vector control of the asynchronous machine based on Kalman filter. A control system block diagram is presented along with a functional scheme of the original speed observer using dynamic system state vector filter estimator. The synthesis of current regulator using machine parameters determined by inverse r model is shown. The method of a control matrix dimension reduction is proposed by removal the flux linkage calculations out of Kalman filter algorithms. Current and speed regulators, as well as a flux estimator, were implemented in the Mexbios Development Studio simulation environment. The robustness of a speed observer and the efficiency of the asynchronous machine sensorless control system were confirmed by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Asynchronous electric drive power-hardware-in-the-loop system
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Power Hardware-in-the-Loop (PHiL) system for asynchronous electric drives application based on power inverter with Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based control system is discussed. Proposed PHiL structure and scheme for asynchronous electric drives are under discussion as well. Described PHiL can be used for power inverters multi-stage testing.

articleTitle: Industrial application of a linear drive system in a pump testing facility
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Low oil prices push the demand for efficient oil and gas production, especially in mature fields. Reducing the costs of artificial lift systems by increasing efficiency is mandatory for extending meantime between failure, economic limit and increasing recovery factor. To achieve these goals, the Pump Testing Facility was established in Leoben for low risk, low cost, and high-performance testing of new technologies including various artificial lift systems. Montanuniversitaet Leoben constructed this facility to overcome the enormous field testing costs and to speed up innovation. The initial objective of the Pump Testing Facility was to test and optimize sucker rod pumps. Due to the inflexibility of the standard surface pump jack, an industrial linear drive system is selected as a prime mover for the down hole pumping system. The highly sophisticated control unit of the AC drive is able to describe, on one hand, the same motion profile as a standard pump jack. On the other hand, it is even more powerful because of its ability to perform any required motion profile. The AC linear drive system is in addition equipped with a powerful monitoring system that allows quick data recording and analysis. This paper summarizes concept and capabilities of this unique testing facility, its performance, and planned applications, demonstrating advantages towards conventional developments and testing. The case studies have already shown that the employed AC linear drive system can be applied in the field as well, making this kind of artificial lift system cheaper, smarter and more flexible. As an integral part of the chair's research programs, new technologies, self-development, and patents will be tested before being applied in fields, using the AC linear drive system. In close cooperation with the industry, this pump testing facility will be expanded to cover more special operational modes and events that may occur in the field.

articleTitle: Improved efficiency machines with integrated control and protection system for AC drives
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In this paper, construction features and operation mode of AC electric machine with improved efficiency are presented. The system of control and protection (C&P) of this machine includes power thyristors and placed inside the machine housing. One version of the machine with C&P system is described. Application field of C&P system is reviewed. The high efficiency electric machine has compact windings with irregular cross-section rectangular conductors. Proposed in the article methodic allows to calculate phase resistance and end winding leakage for new compact construction of stator winding. The advantages of new type of AC machine with compact winding and integrated C&P system are shown.

articleTitle: Frequency elastic drive system operation of sucker rod pumping system
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The scope of this initiative is to introduce a frequency elastic drive system for sucker rod pumping systems to reduce operating costs, provide a grid load at reduced power peaks as well as to increase the meantime between failures (MTBF) by reducing stresses in the system. Field test results of the presented operation mode, obtained by an efficient monitoring system, have shown promising results. Conventional electrical engine driven sucker rod pumping systems operate under a constant motor frequency of normally 50Hz. If equipped with a variable speed drive (VSD), the frequency can vary but is still kept constant over the whole pumping cycle. As a result of the constant rotation speed, the system components are suffering under given peak loads and torques coming from the load behavior. The methodology presented enables an operation mode that is able to reduce high accelerations and decelerations of the system during one pumping cycle by adjusting the motor frequency automatically according to the system's needs. The key of this methodology is the correct adjustment of the motor frequency, which has to be defined for each sucker rod pumping system individually. Generally, during peak load sections, the frequency is reduced which causes a slowing down of the pumping unit to reduce the load, essentially at the beginning of the upstroke and the downstroke, where the polished rod, respectively the counter weights, are lifted. During the remaining stroke, the system is accelerated to obtain the same cycle time as for the standard fixed frequency operation mode. This paper presents how to specify the frequency elastic operation mode and a case study for different stroke profiles. Recently performed tests and simulations have already shown the successful application of this technology in the field. The most significant results, obtained during the tests, have shown a clear reduction of the peak load at the surface structure, a higher electrical efficiency and a better volumetric efficiency of the downhole pump. In general, the frequency elastic drive operation results in an essential decrease of the electrical energy consumption and a reduction of the systems mechanical stresses, causing a tremendous increase in the lifetime of the sucker rod pumping system. The presented knowledge is essential for the improvement of existing and future sucker rod pumping systems. By using the proposed technology, the system performance as well as the meantime between failures can be extended essentially.

articleTitle: Traction electric euipment set for industrial shunting locomotives
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article describes a way of modernization of industrial shunting locomotives widely used by enterprises in Russia. It is proposed to replace hydro-mechanical transmission of present locomotives with an AC/AC electro-mechanical transmission. Traction electric equipment set for such a modernization is described in details. The approach advantages are considered. The technical and economical viability of such modernization are proved.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of energy-saving asynchronous motor in the rotating coordinates system
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: A mathematical description of electromechanical and electro-magnetic processes in transient modes of an electric drive based on an energy-saving asynchronous motor (ESAM) with individual reactive power compensation was developed. A mathematical description is carried out by the method of space vectors using the theory of determinants. Block diagram of electric drive is compiled, transient processes calculations is made, motor oscillograms of velocity dependence on the electromagnetic torque at direct on-line start and at load demand.

articleTitle: On heating induction motor rotor at start-up of high-inertia mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Paper is devoted to epy research of start-up modes of high-inertial asynchronous electric drives. Here we consider the case of a start with a constant rotational speed of the stator magnetic field. For high-inertia drives, the starting process is very long and can be accompanied by a significant motor overheating. Analytically, as well as using computer simulation, the following is shown: - The larger is the motor size (with other things being equal) - the stronger is the problem of heating the rotor winding in the starting modes; - The lower is the rated motor speed with the same power and the same mechanism, the less is the heating of the rotor winding in the starting modes (at gear ratio of the gearbox corresponding to the rated motor speed and the required speed of the mechanism); - By adjusting the acceleration time when starting an induction motor with thyristor voltage converter it is impossible to solve the problem of the rotor winding overheating.

articleTitle: Vector control system of PMSM based on self-commutated voltage inverter with relay controlled IGBT switch in DC link
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper discusses the vector control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) based on relay controlled IGBT switch in the DC link and relay controlled output inverter current. The working process of this system with and without IGBT in the DC link switch as well as the harmonic analysis of PMSM stator current were researched by using the mathematical model designed in Mathlab Simulink. The structure of mathematical model, functional charts and the simulation data are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Development of methods for improving energy and resource efficiency of electrical equipment when applying the concept of proactive diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This article exposes the concept of the proactive diagnosis of asynchronous drives. One of the elements for this concept is localization and studying various factors leading to faults. One of the most common faults is short-circuit in wiring. A finite element model of an asynchronous drive is used to create a model for such fault. A mathematical description of the engine's stator wiring is presented in this model. A short-circuit in wiring is modeled by changing resistance of the stator's grooves for one phase. Model results are processed by continuous wavelet transformation. The presence of a fault like wiring short-circuit can be characterized by an increased number of subinterval and threshold levels for noise rejection. Data acquired on operational equipment validate the results of modeling.

articleTitle: Induction generator based on doubly-fed machine
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The authors analyzed the approach to implement a self-contained generator based on an induction motor with a wound rotor with connection of a stator circuit to the load and with the power supply of rotor windings from a regulated source of alternating current. The article provides a diagram for the power balance in the generator set and defines the boundaries of a sustainable electricity generation. The authors carried out experimental research which confirmed the data obtained during the simulation. The zones of the generator effective operation are determined.

Author Keywords: induction motor with a wound rotor

articleTitle: Active power reserve determination for power system with high share of solar generation
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The most significant feature of solar power plants is stochastic nature of their operation which causes the main problem - difficulties in short-term and long-term power system operation planning. In this paper statistical analysis of the actual and planned solar power plants' archive data of the real power system is presented. On the basis of the investigated solar generation data some features were identified allowing determination of the magnitude and nature of solar power plants deviation from the plan depending on season and period of the day. Based on the research presented in this paper, an augmented approach was developed to determine expected generation capacity deviations in power system with a high penetration of solar power plants. The approach allows modification of existing method for determination of the constraints which are being imposed by System Operator during unit commitment for ensuring system reliability with solar power plants irregular fluctuations taken into account.

articleTitle: Complex load bus static load characteristics determination using passive experiment method
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The present article is devoted to the issues of determining the static load characteristics by the passive experiment with the aim of improving the quality of control over the electric power system operation modes and reducing the amount of control actions from the emergency control devices. The problems of filtering a priori information identifying the dependencies of active and reactive power are considered, a technique for determining the regulating effect of the load and estimating the static load characteristics on the basis of a real power area are proposed. In addition, the problems of determining the error are considered, a solution realized on the basis of the principal component method that provides an increase in the accuracy of the passive experiment is proposed.

articleTitle: Increasing energy efficiency of asynchronous electric drive control by Takagi-Sugeno method
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article is devoted to development of the control models for asynchronous electric drives. The modern microprocessor technique allows realizing any algorithm of electric drive functioning, therefore, there is a search capability of new control algorithms asynchronous electric drives with the criterion increase in their energy efficiency. The work offers scalar and vector type control models based on one of the artificial intelligence areas: fuzzy logic. In case of a scalar type control modeling, the cosφ range of values of the membership function was selected as one of the the integral parameters of the electric drive energy efficiency. A mathematical model of an electric drive was considered in case of vector control for an asynchronous electric drive taking into account non-linearity of its magnetization response. The algorithm implementing saturation of the drive magnetic system was made using the Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy inference.

articleTitle: Simplified method of taking into account temperature fluctuations influence on durability of induction motors stator winding insulation
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The problem of taking into account of the influence of the induction motor stator winding temperature fluctuations on the rate of winding insulation aging is discussed. Investigations were carried out on the basis of clustering of the general industry TEFC motors with following creation generalized 5-node thermodynamic models of TEFC motors for each cluster. Random loading mode of electric drive with uniform distribution law was simulated. Values of the coefficient of thermal resource of insulation expenditure were received with employment of generalized thermodynamic models. On the basis of these results expressions for approximate taking into account influence of the temperature fluctuations on acceleration of the insulation thermal resource expenditure were received. Simple method of accounting of this influence on the stage of selection and checking of induction motors for electric drives, working with random loading was proposed.

articleTitle: Control principles of AC electric drives
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: An algorithm for the synthesis of a control signal in the torque contour of AC electric drives is proposed. It is based upon the spectral analysis of harmonic current and conductancies along the air gap which is applicable to any electric machine with a magnetic non-symmetry of a rotor and combines the method of winding functions and the energy method of obtaining the electric drive's coordinates (MDS, induction, EMF, electromagnetic torque). In addition, it also allows one to search for the optimal shape of current according to the principle of the electric machine operation. Under this algorithm it is recommended to perform optimization calculations under the following assumptions: the converter is not saturated, steel magnetic conductivity is equal to infinity, and there are no scattering fluxes. An example of the best form of the phase currents of an electric drive with a synchronous independent-excitation reaction machine synthesis is shown.

articleTitle: Estimation of energy saving in electric drives of traction-blowing mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper provides the comparative analysis of energy consumption by the fans of forced-draft mechanisms. The mathematical description of an object was for this purpose developed, rated schemes of energy consumption of an object at the different control laws are given. The comparison of rated findings of energy consumption by the fan electric drive at throttle regulation and with the use of the directing devices showed that during the system work in the minimum points the control of the directing devices allows one to save up to 25% of energy. This effect significantly decreases during the work of a technology object with nominal pressures. Taking the aforementioned into account, the refusal of throttle regulation in favor of the directing devices is possible when a technology object works for an essential time with the lowered pressure.

Author Keywords: electric drives of pumps and fans

articleTitle: Analysis of application of magnetic flux controller with phase-locked loop for synchronous reluctance drive
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper presents a model of synchronous reluctance motor with digital control system and simple open loop flux estimator. The angular position of the stator flux linkage and rotational speed are derived from the integration of the back-EMF using phase locked loop (PLL). The advantages of this approach are considered. The model takes into account the discreteness of the controller and some errors in estimating the voltage vector that arise in such a control system. The features of the motor operation without position/flux feedback as well as with a simple open-loop flux estimator are considered. The model can be used to design a synchronous reluctance motor with more complex flux estimators. The model can also be useful for educational purposes, since the structure of the control system in the model corresponds to the real structure of the AC drive microprocessor control.

articleTitle: Power converter with signal frequency and amplitude regulation
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper considers the structure and methods of creating powerful power converters with adjustable output parameters. To change the rotational speed of the shaft of asynchronous engine (AM/E), the method of amplitude modulation is proposed. To modify the engine torque, a method is used to change the capacitance of the capacitor of the PC resonant oscillatory circuit. As a result, the circuit load voltage changes. The proposed solution based on the method of the amplitude modulation with the use of powerful transistor converters makes it possible to amplify a sufficiently weak harmonic input signal (not more than 1.5 W) to tens and hundreds of kilowatts. The use of a two-unit oscillating circuit with a series and parallel capacitors as a part of the power converter allows obtaining an undistorted sinusoidal voltage at the output with amplitude and frequency adjustment. The digital control of key elements of the converter allows formalizing the task of monitoring and diagnostics of the electric drive, including the remote one.

articleTitle: Comparison of optimized PWM techniques for overmodulation region of two-level inverters
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Four optimized PWM algorithms for the overmodulation region are compared in the paper. The optimization is done to minimize the loss-factor, which indicates the harmonic losses of the AC machine. The loss-factors are computed for different pulse ratios as the function of the modulation index. It is shown in the paper that, which technique has the optimal performance in the lower part of overmodulation as the function of the modulation index and the pulse ratio. The calculated results are verified by laboratory tests.

articleTitle: Digital control system with an adaptive feedback loop for AC motor PWM drive
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper presents the developed digital control system with an adaptive feedback loop for AC motor PWM drive which allows one to keep stable closed loop performance of the drive while the PWM frequency can be changed. The adaptation of the drive's dynamic characteristics is implemented by changing parameters of the compensators and the digital filters. The experimental and simulation results for 9 kW high-speed drive confirm stable control loop performance with nearly equal frequency and time responses at both simulated PWM frequencies.

articleTitle: Energy storage devices
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: A great variety of types of storage devices, as well as the increasing role of their application in energy systems poses the task of choosing one or another type of storage devices for which it is necessary to determine the criteria for their comparison. In this paper, it is proposed to use the value of the exergetic efficiency as a universal criterion for selecting a storage ring which most correctly characterizes the thermodynamic efficiency of any types of storage devices.

articleTitle: Approach to diagnosing and predicting the technical conditions of propulsion motors
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: One of the directions determining the improvement of the quality of control and diagnostics of the technical condition of the electrical equipment of ships is considered. A new algorithm for diagnosing the technical state of propulsion motors based on the representation of a propulsion motor by a variable object is proposed. Its operation consists in transforming the structure of an object under the influence of various factors, taking into account the mutual influence of diagnostic features on the state of the object and allowing to assess the technical state of any rowing electric motor from a single methodological standpoint. The parameters of diagnostics of propulsion motors are determined. A functional and mathematical model for diagnosing of propulsion motors has been created. A complex approach to the construction of an algorithm for the technical diagnosis of propulsion motors based on the logical diagnosis model is proposed.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of wireless sensor network powered through neutral to earth voltage
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: A low power wireless sensor network utilizing the neutral to earth voltage as a power source is developed and analyzed. It consists of a batteryless energy harvesting powered wireless sensor nodes, a gateway (if needed) and a local or remote server (if used). An invasive energy harvesting method to use the voltage between the neutral conductor and the ground conductor is used for the sensor module. A test network is built in a household. Statistics of the household's electric current and the corresponding neutral conductor's voltage is obtained during a two months period. The statistics is further processed to verify the working principle of the proposed network and to enlighten its strengths and weaknesses. The sensor nodes are developed using widely existing electronic components and don't require specialized devices.

articleTitle: Calculation of relay protection and automation failure risks
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper is aimed to the development of the algorithm for the risk calculation for the primary circuit objects according to the installed secondary equipment. The algorithm is based on the introduced graph probabilistic model taking into account the network topology, equipment state conditions, responsibility of consumers and short-circuits probability. The IEEE 14 test scheme was used as input data for a primary network while the information about secondary circuit's security was obtained from previous authors papers. The results show that the algorithm could calculate the risk of relay protection outage. To predict possible influence of relay system reconstruction it is required to change the probability indices, thus, the decrement of the system risk will be an indicator of system improvement. By comparing the risk decrement in different investment strategies it is possible to define which one is the best. The algorithm may be used for a reasonable planning of the relay protection replacement priority.

articleTitle: Simulation of controlling alternative current actuator on neural network basis
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper discusses the problem of the alternative current actuator control. The algorithm is based on the second method of A. M. Lyapunov. The dependence of the components of the stator voltage on the maximum voltage, that is applied to the motor, is considered. The possibility of the selection method of neural networks to predict characteristics is discussed. The algorithm, based on the neural networks, for predicting the characteristics of the alternative current actuator is developed. The generalized regression neural network structure is given. The structure of the 1st hidden network layer of generalized regression neural network is shown. The final statistics and the value errors are given.

articleTitle: Active energy filter for compensation of harmonic distortion in motor soft starter
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: For more than half a century of the exploitation of controlled electric drive systems built on semiconductor elements thyristor converter devices proved to be the most reliable and cost-effective systems. Thyristor voltage converters (TVC) are used as soft starters (MSS) for powerful asynchronous electric drives and are promising in terms of their use as systems with an economizer and for the development of devices to control the drive speed. However, the use of TVC causes significant harmonic distortion of the shape of the current consumed. The excessively consumed reactive power, direct current consumption, current pulses lead to the emergence of additional losses of electrical energy in the elements of the power-supply system, accelerate the aging of insulation of current-carrying parts of equipment and negatively influence its electromagnetic compatibility. While for a soft starter with rare starts of the drive these effects can be neglected, due to the shunting of the TVC after acceleration of the engine, for a soft starter with frequent starts and systems where the TVC remains in the operation after acceleration, they must be taken into account. In this paper, the authors describe a solution directed at compensating the harmonic distortion of the consumable current in systems with a TVC. The main element of the proposed device is an active energy filter (AEF) performed on IGBT-switches controlled by a relay current regulator. The paper contains an analytical overview of compensation process for the harmonic distortion of the current with the help of AEF and considers its structure and selected components. The TVC and the compensation device operation was investigated by mathematical simulation in the software MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Revisiting optimization of 2D tracker application in solar energy
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article contains the results of experimental and theoretical studies on the efficiency of solar power plants using electromechanical systems for sun position tracking. A mathematical model of a 2D solar tracker describing the orientation and energy characteristics is formulated. The net energy gain inclusive of consumption of the orientation system motors is demonstrated to be the feasibility criterion of the tracking system application. An appropriate number of receiver displacements made during a daily cycle is determined both experimentally and theoretically to be around 30.

articleTitle: Estimation accuracy of method for calculating stator current vector components in vector control systems
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The questions of an accuracy estimation of the methods for a calculation the projections of a current vector of a stator in vector control systems are considered in this article. The existing methods for calculating the projections of the vector of the stator current deal with the relative amplitude value of the total current and the simplified equation of the no-load current. A new method based on the exact calculation in the complex form of the vector projections is proposed. A criterion for the accuracy of methods based on the relative error of the electromagnetic moment is chosen and a comparison is made. The proposed calculation methods provide an error of 1.4 ± 1.7% compared to the error of 3.75 ± 1.5% and 3.9 ± 9.9% for other methods.

articleTitle: Universal and energy efficient transistor autonomous inverter on semiconductor switches
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Asynchronous motors are widely used in many industries. This is due to their relative cheapness and simplicity of production. But the realization of their full potential requires the use of additional devices, for example, frequency converters, which allow you to regulate the speed of an asynchronous motor without increasing the dimensions of the engine. Frequency converters have a wide range of possible designs, which allows one to choose the most suitable for the operating conditions and required functions. The authors considered various frequency converters and their advantages and disadvantages in this article. Also, there are original single-cycle and two-stroke transient frequency converters developed at the Department of Electrical Engineering and Automated Electric Drives of AltGTU after I.I. Polzunova with special transitional keys in the presented material.

articleTitle: Three phase flux switching machine with hybrid excitation — Design and implementation
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Flux switching machines with hybrid excitation offer several interesting features compared to conventional permanent magnet machines. Since the permanent magnets as well as the excitation winding are mounted on the stator, cooling can be performed easily. Also, the usage of slip rings can be avoided. A simple rotor structure employs the possibility to operate the machine in a high speed range. This paper presents two types of flux switching machines with hybrid excitation. Their benefits and drawbacks are discussed. The Finite Element Analysis simulation results as well as measurement data of a prototype machine are presented.

articleTitle: Research and development of exoskeletons with synchronous electric drive of various type
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The comparison of the operation of the exoskeleton electromechanical part with the vector and valve electric drive by the example of the knee joint exoskeleton was done in this paper. The construction features of these electric drive systems were described. Functional diagrams were presented. The advantages of both systems were described and shortcomings of both construction methods were analyzed. A control system was built on the basis of the classical principles of subordinate regulation systems. The mathematical modeling of both systems was conducted. It was found that the electric drive with a brushless DC motor is more suitable for exoskeletons, since it has the same displacement parameters with lower requirements for control system and mass parameters of the exoskeleton.

articleTitle: On reliability and energy efficiency increasing of the vehicles electric drives
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Problem of the reliability increasing of the vehicles electric drives is discussed in context of the reduction of the electric motor heating during variable character of movement. Opportunities of the induction motor stator winding heating reduction by means of the control of the vehicles electric drives in transient and steady state modes of movement are shown. Analytical expressions for dynamic torque, optimal on minimal of the winding temperature rise during acceleration, as well as expressions for dynamic torque and value of the motor torque limitation, optimal on energy consumption during acceleration are presented. It is shown that desire to reduce the stator winding temperature rise by means of dynamic torque optimal value selection or motor torque limitation can lead to the rise of energy consumption. Results of the modeling are presented.

articleTitle: Power semiconductor converter optimization of electric drive
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper presents the optimization of power circuits of multiphase semiconductor converters which powered synchronous reluctance electric drives. In the general case, currents leak through power circuits which form is different from a sinusoidal one. By way of the optimization criterion of main-circuit connections, the condition was assumed to provide the maximum torque created by the electric drive. The second stage presents an algorithm for numerical optimization of the phase current form in multiphase synchronous reluctance electric drives. The dependence of the pulsations of the electromagnetic torque as a function of the number of phases in an electric machine is obtained. It is established that an increase in the number of phases greater than 6 does not significantly reduce the pulsations of the electromagnetic torque. A further increase in the number of phases leads to an increase in the cost of the semiconductor converter.

articleTitle: On viability of application of electromagnetic bearings for electric propulsion installations (EPI)
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: A three-loop control system of radial electromagnetic bearing (EMB) for electric propulsion installations (EPI) is proposed. In the open state the system is unstable and has the features which must be considered while synthesizing the regulator. The issues of creating a pulse system and different variants of constructing the inner current circuit are considered. The construction of the control system is carried out in accordance with the general principles of building systems of subordinate regulation. To calculate the parameters of regulators, the authors used the method of transfer functions and z-transformation method. It is shown that the best performance in speed and overshoot has a relay regulator operating in a sliding mode. In accordance with the mathematical model of EMB and its corresponding structural diagrams, simulation models are built in the Matlab Simulink software package. As a result of simulating a pulsed electromagnetic bearing control system, transient processes on control and disturbance impacts are obtained. The analysis of transient processes in simulation showed that electromagnetic bearings equipped with a three-loop control system have a high static rigidity and high operating speed.

articleTitle: Specific parameters comparison of synchronous reluctance electric drives
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article presents the principles of comparison of different types of synchronous contactless electric drives. The mathematical description of the system is given for comparison. It is shown that classical unregulated synchronous electric drives are inferior to induction electric drives by 30-40%. It is caused by both a decrease in excitation and a decrease in the limiting load angle according to the conditions of static stability. The phase current of electric drives with FRRM has a rectangular shape which allows one to significantly improve the weight and dimensions. In this case, the electric drive with FRRM due to the compensation of the armature transverse response allows improving the system characteristics, so that the induction motor is 10-15% less than the FRRM.

articleTitle: Control system of energy storage device as part of frequency-regulated AC electric drive
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The research paper is devoted to the development and investigation of the energy storage control system as a part of a frequency-regulated AC drive. The statement of the problem is given and the plant of investigation is described. The structure of a two-loop control system for an energy storage device based on the principles of subordinate control of the coordinates and including the internal loop of the external DC/DC converter current and the external DC-link circuit of the frequency converter is constructed. The research purpose is devoted to the system dynamic properties identification. The structure of control system regulators is disclosed. The results of modeling the control system processes, under the influence of the DC/AC converter test load, simulating the starting and braking modes of a regulated AC drive are presented. The obtained information can be valuable in the control system structure of the energy accumulation device selecting.

articleTitle: Considering magnetic circuit saturation in calculation of electric drives operating with large overloads by torque
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article outlines the problems of calculating electric drives operating in the zone of significant overloads. An algorithm for parallel finite element calculation methods is presented which is performed using the criterion of minimum calculation time. It is shown that if the electric machine is represented by a system with distributed parameters, in the zone of significant overloads the calculated values of the electromagnetic torque can be substantially refined. Thus, in the electric drives of high power (above 500 kW) with a relatively small stator back, it is possible to clarify the value of the maximum permissible torque by (15–20) %.

articleTitle: Interpolation error estimation of synchronous reluctance electric drive efficiency at various load points of booster heat pump profile
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Turbomachines are important equipment in many industrial and residential sectors. Booster heat pumps represent a significant share among them. A duty cycle of a booster heat pump depends on a specific load profile. The research is devoted to the problems of calculation and interpolation of the efficiency of the synchronous reluctance electric drive in booster heat pump. In order to estimate the pump unit performance, a semi-analytical model on the basis of experimental data on the selected operating modes is used. The various approaches of interpolation error estimation based on the data of synchronous reluctance motor drive efficiency are described and estimated.

articleTitle: Developing electric drive with adaptive algorithm for soft switching between frequency converter and three-phase mains
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper presents a new approach for induction motor (IM) soft switching from frequency converter (FC) to mains and vice versa. Industrial companies' and municipal services' proper operating require numerous complex systems interconnection and cooperation the structure of which depends on the company's type. The frequency control station (FCS) is one of the abovementioned systems. The FCS application for industrial unit group control is usually a technically and economically reasonable solution. Despite all the advantages, the solution provides a dangerous mode which could appear while operating. The article deals with AC electric drive transient at supply voltage loss. The reason for particular attention paid to the voltage loss's processes stands for its connection with FCS operating. The paper conducts detailed investigation of the IM switching processes between FC and mains. Besides, it considers the probable risk estimation. The technique proposed in the article intends to eliminate probable emergency operation while switching. The authors suggest soft switching technique, its schematic circuit implementation and a closed-loop control system designing and calculation. Schematic circuit components' selection guideline is also proposed.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic power plants participation in frequency and voltage regulation
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper presents the features of emergency processes in isolated power systems and island operation modes involving frequency and voltage regulations by photovoltaic power plants (PVPPs). On the basis of calculations it is proved that when using frequency-independent control of PVPP inverters, power shortage conditions are much more difficult for consumers of electric power. Requirements for PVPP participation in frequency and voltage regulation are presented, and the features of PVPP inverter control algorithms are analyzed in normal and emergency operation conditions of the grid. The necessity of imposing the technical requirements for PVPP inverters and their control algorithms is considered, including participation in the implementation of emergency automation algorithms for the adjacent grid at the stage of technological connection of PVPP based on transient conditions calculations.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2018 17th International Ural Conference on AC Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: machine control; electric drives; stators; induction motor drives; induction motors; invertors; rotors; machine vector control; frequency convertors; AC motor drives.
